Tiles from an MBTiles file

Source: R/tiles.R
rr_tiles_mbtiles.Rd

A tile function for an rr_layer() that reads its tiles from an MBTiles file (SQLite), such as the image tiles of elevations a dem layer draws. The file is opened once, read-only, and stays open while the function lives.

Usage

rr_tiles_mbtiles(file)

Arguments

file

An MBTiles file: a tiles table (zoom_level, tile_column, tile_row in the TMS order, from the south, and tile_data) and a metadata table of name and value.

Value

A function function(z, x, y) (y from the north, as the page asks) returning a tile's bytes, or NULL where the file has none; with the file's format, bounds, minzoom, maxzoom, encoding and tile_size as attributes where its metadata give them, which rr_layer() takes for a dem layer, and source, the file's path, by which rr_bundle() writes the tiles of layers on one file once.

See also

rr_layer()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("RSQLite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".mbtiles")
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), f)
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "metadata", data.frame(
    name = c("format", "encoding", "bounds", "minzoom", "maxzoom"),
    value = c("png", "terrarium", "-30,60,-5,70", "0", "1")
  ))
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE tiles (zoom_level INTEGER, tile_column INTEGER, tile_row INTEGER,
                       tile_data BLOB)")
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "INSERT INTO tiles VALUES (1, 0, 1, ?)", params = list(list(as.raw(1:4))))
  DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
  tiles <- rr_tiles_mbtiles(f)
  tiles(1, 0, 0) # the north-west tile at zoom 1, row 1 counted from the south
  attributes(tiles)[c("format", "encoding", "bounds")]
}
#> $format
#> [1] "png"
#> 
#> $encoding
#> [1] "terrarium"
#> 
#> $bounds
#> [1] -30  60  -5  70
#>
